description_en: Removes networking information from an Edge Private Network (EPN) instance. This operation applies only to internal networks
description_zh: 调用RemoveVSwitchesFromEpnInstance进行组网信息删除，针对内网有效
name: RemoveVSwitchesFromEpnInstance

parameters.help_en: The Edge Private Network (EPN) instance ID. The NetworkingModel of the EPN instance must be Connection or SpeedUpAndConnection. The SpeedUp pattern does not support vSwitch operations
parameters.help_zh:
边边通信实例ID。

EPN 实例的 NetworkingModel 必须为 Connection 或 SpeedUpAndConnection；SpeedUp 模式不支持 VSwitch 操作
parameters.name: epn_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The internal network configuration information to remove
parameters.help_zh: 要删除的内网组网信息
parameters.name: vswitches_info
